svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.9.17 Separation of Public Corridors
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.9.17 Separation of Public Corridors
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Separation of Public Corridors

g.text: Public corridor: fire separation of at
least 45 min from the rest of the building
supervised, signal to the fire department:
fire separation with no rating required
As in (2), and the corridor is over 5 m
Sprinklered floor area: washroom open to the
corridor, both separated from the rest of the
storey, fixtures not in a dwelling unit or suite

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Public corridors are separated from the remainder of the building
by a fire separation having not less than a 45 min fire-resistance
rating
Except as otherwise required by this Part and as provided in Sentences
In other than residential occupancies, no fire-resistance rating is
required for the fire separation between a public corridor and the
remainder of the building if
(a) the floor area is sprinklered, (b) the sprinkler system is
electrically supervised in conformance with Sentence 3.2.4.9.(3), and (c)
its operation causes a signal to be transmitted to the fire department in
conformance with Sentence 3.2.4.7.(4).
In other than residential occupancies, no fire separation is
required between a public corridor and the remainder of the
building if
Clauses (a) to (c) of Sentence (2) are met, and (d) the corridor exceeds
5 m (16′-4⅞″) in width.
A public corridor in a house with a secondary suite is separated
from the remainder of the spaces in the house by a fire separation
rated
(a) not less than 15 min when all smoke alarms in the house are
photo-electric and interconnected as in Clause 9.10.19.5.(2)(a) (see also
Sentence 9.10.3.1.(2)), (b) not less than 30 min when additional
photo-electric smoke alarms are installed and interconnected as in Clause
9.10.19.5.(2)(b) (see also Sentence 9.10.3.1.(3)), (c) not less than 45
min when smoke alarms are not installed and interconnected as in (a) or
(b), or (d) no rating if the building is sprinklered.
No fire separation is required in a sprinklered floor area between
a public corridor and a space containing plumbing fixtures required
by Article 3.7.2.2. and Section 9.31., provided
(a) the space and the corridor are separated from the remainder of the
storey by a fire separation rated not less than that required between the
corridor and the remainder of the storey, and (b) the plumbing fixtures
are not located within a dwelling unit or suite.
Drawn: floor plans, walls cut low. Red: rated fire separations. Pale pink: fire separation with no rating. Sentence (4) is in the panel.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.9.17. (page 9-72)
